notes.title: Streamer Guide for Turbo Live
notes.content:
[h1]Turbo Live in Stream[/h1]

[h2]Twitch[/h2]

Turbo Live offers full integration with Twitch. This integration allows you to quickly connect to your Twitch account and interact with your community while playing.

[list]
[*]🔌Quick connection to your Twitch account
[*]⭐Unique commands tailored to Twitch (in-game messages, polls, etc.)
[*]🎮Full game support
[*]💬Commands accessible from the chat or via whispers to the bot "duckreaction"
[/list]

[h2]Other Streaming Platforms[/h2]

Don't use Twitch for streaming? No problem! We offer an alternative solution to play with your community from any streaming platform.

[list]
[*]⌨Twitch commands mapped to the streamer's keyboard keys
[*]🛠Option to use a third-party tool to give access to keyboard commands via chat
[*]📺Stream without using Twitch
[/list]

Simply launch "Streamer" mode and select the "Keyboard" option when starting the mode. Then, use a third-party tool to give your community access to keyboard commands. For example, StreamerBot is available here: [url=https://streamer.bot/]https://streamer.bot/[/url]

[b]Here’s a step-by-step video on how to install StreamerBot:[/b]
[previewyoutube=A3c5up77fgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy streaming!

notes.title: Update Notes - November 14, 2024 - Performance Adjustments
notes.content:
We’ve optimized Turbo Live to automatically adapt to your machine’s performance. No need to adjust settings; everything is auto-tuned! 💻

FPS are now capped at 60 for smooth visuals without draining your PC’s resources. Perfect for streamers, ensuring a smoother streaming experience.

Thanks for your feedback, and happy gaming! 🚗💨
